crop.notes: Whole sporting column (Pendragon on Coburn, McAuliffe-Myer, Fogarty); the Allen item is the last one, 'Jack King to Mike Boden', complete.

summary.suggested: In a letter to the St. Louis Post-Dispatch, Jack King said he had $50 in Tom Allen's hands to fight Mike Boden in any style, and told Boden to cover it or stop talking.

metadata.notes: Masthead: St. Louis Post-Dispatch, Saturday, January 17, 1891, page 8.

notes: Allen only holds the stake for King's challenge; stakeholder detail skipped per rubric.
